design.processName: Job-work subcontracting: issuing forged blanks from Chakan to heat treatment and shot blasting vendors, receiving them back at Chakan or directly at Bhosari, and settling the vendor's per-kg charges

keyDesignDecisions.topic: Negative stock on job-work issues: allow it in SAP or block the issue until stock is posted

options.name: Allow negative stock for job-work issues only, with a standing exception list
options.pros: Matches what the MD asks for and keeps the forge running when the posting lags; the exception list gives stores a daily job to clear.
options.cons: Needs standard configuration and possibly an extension in a public-cloud system where negative stock is restricted; stock-at-vendor report can briefly overstate what is physically out.

options.name: Prohibit negative stock and make the forge posting a precondition of the issue
options.pros: Cleanest stock accuracy and no workaround to reverse later; production supervisors would wait for the confirmation posting.
options.cons: Changes the daily habit at Chakan and can stop dispatch when the forge confirmation is late.

options.name: Allow negative stock across all movements in both company codes
options.pros: No behavioural change from Tally; simplest adoption for users.
options.cons: Doubles the risk to stock accuracy and conflicts with the transfer-pricing and intercompany needs of the two legal entities.

keyDesignDecisions.recommendation: Allow negative stock for job-work issues only, with a standing exception list
keyDesignDecisions.rationale: rq_75dcff2e-f6e3-46b7-8234-8b41ed013446_4 reproduces the MD's instruction and the exception list keeps the control visible. Scope and the parallel Tally run for the LLP are unsettled, so this applies once pending JBW-OQ-2 is answered; feasibility in the public-cloud release must be confirmed.

keyDesignDecisions.topic: Where stock lying at a job-worker is held: a standard subcontracting construct or a bespoke vendor-stock object

options.name: Use the standard subcontracting flow with material provided to the vendor and a stock-at-vendor view
options.pros: Standard handover of components to the vendor, challan and receipt against the same reference, and a vendor-stock view come with the product; upgrade-stable.
options.cons: Restricts flexibility in the weight-versus-piece tolerances and needs careful setup of the vendor-held stock for six vendors.

options.name: Custom vendor-stock app outside the core
options.pros: Whatever reconciliation tolerance and layout Chakan wants.
options.cons: Two truths for the same stock, extra budget, and no clean link to costing or ITC-04.

keyDesignDecisions.recommendation: Use the standard subcontracting flow with material provided to the vendor and a stock-at-vendor view
keyDesignDecisions.rationale: The stock-at-vendor report, the challan and the receipt against the challan are the core of rq_1a07365d-2140-48cb-ade9-6a82d0f2b758_8 and rq_bd3b7814-b437-48c1-b511-3e9761b48f21_13; standard-first order puts a bespoke object last, and the budget of INR 2.5 crore does not favour duplication. Detail level and closure tolerance are held on pending JBW-OQ-8.

fitGap.justification: Vendor-held subcontract stock with issue/receipt postings is delivered standard, so the monthly reconciliation reads postings rather than an Excel tick-sheet; no cleaner class is bypassed. Reconciliation detail level and closure tolerance remain open (JBW-OQ-8).
fitGap.validationReason: No verified SAP catalog for this release; a consultant must confirm the standard subcontract-stock reconciliation covers per-challan, per-heat closure.

fitGap.justification: A system GST challan created at issue and a return period report from the same postings is customising of the subcontracting and GST setup, replacing the paper triplicate and Excel register; nothing needs a build.
fitGap.validationReason: Consultant to confirm the standard GST movement document for job-work and the ITC-04 report are configuration in 2702.

masterDataPrerequisites.object: Vendor master for the 6 job-workers, with MSME status and due-date settings
masterDataPrerequisites.migrationSource: Existing vendor list held by finance and AP; completeness to be confirmed by the business
masterDataPrerequisites.creationChannel: Loaded at cutover from the current vendor list; new vendors created through the standard vendor create request and approval.
masterDataPrerequisites.governance: A new or changed vendor is approved by Accounts Payable Executive; a record without GSTIN or MSME status is incomplete and blocked from payment runs.

masterDataPrerequisites.object: Material master for forged blanks and treated blanks, batch-managed with heat number
masterDataPrerequisites.migrationSource: Current part list from the Excel cost and pricing sheets; the business confirms part-wise unit and weight
masterDataPrerequisites.creationChannel: Loaded at cutover as an initial material load; later created through the standard material create process.
masterDataPrerequisites.governance: The Production Supervisor owns the blank and treated-blank materials; a material without batch management or a unit of measure is rejected at creation.

dataMigration.object: Vendor master and subcontracting rate records for the 6 job-workers
dataMigration.source: Current vendor list and per-kg rate agreements held by finance, AP and the Chakan plant office
dataMigration.approach: Load, then cleanse: deduplicate, add GSTIN and MSME status, attach the current per-kg rate per part; reconcile to the purchase orders raised in the last two months.
dataMigration.risk: MSME status missing on a vendor pushes payments past 45 days from day one; the business must confirm each vendor's status.

dataMigration.object: Material master, batch-management settings and part list for forged and treated blanks
dataMigration.source: Excel cost and pricing sheets, plus the machining plan from Bhosari
dataMigration.approach: Load, cleanse and assign unit of measure kg, batch management and the heat-number attribute; reconcile part count to the customer price lists.
dataMigration.risk: Parts priced in Excel may not carry a clean part-to-customer mapping, so heat traceability and part-wise margin start on an incomplete list.

cutover.activity: Freeze new job-work issues at Chakan at the last dispatch before go-live; dispatches during the freeze are noted on paper and keyed after go-live.
cutover.risk: Lots leaving Chakan without a system challan during the freeze break the no-material-without-challan control.

cutover.activity: Load and reconcile vendor master, material master and subcontracting rate records for the 6 job-workers.
cutover.risk: A missing rate record blocks invoice verification on day one.

periodEndActivities.activity: Reconcile stock at each of the 6 job-workers per vendor, part and heat against the vendor's signed balance and clear or escalate every open challan line.
Run the open-job-work review (invoices without receipt match, weight and piece differences above tolerance) and release or block payment accordingly.

interfaces.counterpartSystem: GST IRP and e-way bill portal via GSP
interfaces.triggerFrequency: Event: on every job-work challan issued at the Chakan gate, and on every customer dispatch document; volume about 70% of 900 tonnes a month issued to vendors plus customer dispatches
interfaces.payload: Job-work challan documents and customer GST e-invoices and e-way bills with part, quantity, weight and value
interfaces.validationReason: Confirm the released GSP connection for e-invoice and e-way bill in release 2702, and whether the job-work movement document is carried on the same connection.

failureHandling.detection: Rejected documents show on the interface error list and the document keeps a not-transmitted status instead of the issued status.
failureHandling.alerting: The exception list is mailed to the finance team each hour.
failureHandling.rerun: Finance corrects the master data or tax detail and resends only the rejected document.
failureHandling.idempotency: The government reference number returned on success is stored on the document; a resend with the same document number is not issued a second time.

interfaces.systemOfRecord: The counterpart (government portal) for the issued invoice and e-way bill numbers; SAP for the underlying document.

interfaces.triggerFrequency: Event: schedules and call-offs received on publication; ASN sent at each dispatch from JBW-7-1
interfaces.payload: Monthly delivery schedules and weekly call-offs per part and customer inward; packing list, ASN and dispatch data outward
interfaces.validationReason: Whether the released schedule-agreement and advance-shipping interfaces cover all three customer portals or whether a middleware mapping per portal is needed is pending JBW-OQ-10.

failureHandling.detection: Failed schedule uploads and rejected ASNs appear in the interface monitor and on the error list of the affected scheduling agreement or dispatch.
failureHandling.alerting: The sales coordinator is mailed for schedule failures and the dispatch team for ASN failures.
failureHandling.rerun: The coordinator corrects the part or schedule line and re-uploads that message only.
failureHandling.idempotency: The customer's schedule and call-off numbers are stored on the schedule lines, so a repeated upload updates instead of adding lines; the ASN carries the dispatch document number.

interfaces.systemOfRecord: SAP holds the schedule agreement and the dispatch; the customer portal holds the customer's own release and the acknowledged ASN.

kpis.baseline: not provided — current value to be measured by Chief Financial Officer from today's records before go-live

kpis.validationReason: Confirm the released stock-at-vendor report in release 2702; in the source audit qualification the unreconciled value was INR 3.2 crore, used as narrative context only.

kpis.baseline: not provided — current value to be measured by Chief Financial Officer from today's records before go-live

objectives.statement: Know exactly how much forged material sits with each of the six job-work vendors, by part and heat, so the auditor's reconciliation exception cannot recur.
Give Tata and Hyundai parts a traceable heat number from the vendor return onward, so the certification requirement no longer puts the business at risk.

scopeStatements.statement: Forged blanks issued from Chakan (plant 2100, Shaktiman Forge LLP) to the six heat treatment and shot blasting job-workers under a system GST challan, and their tracked return.
scopeStatements.reason: This is the boundary the business set: the flow starts at Chakan forging and ends when treated blanks are received.

scopeStatements.statement: Receipt of treated blanks against the original challan, with a mandatory heat number and quality inspection, both at Chakan and directly at Bhosari.
scopeStatements.reason: Both arrival paths exist today and both must post against the same challan for the material to be reconciled.

orgStructure.proposal: Company code 1000 for Shaktiman Auto Components Pvt Ltd, holding the Bhosari machining plant, the Hosur assembly plant and the Chennai warehouse.
Company code 2000 for Shaktiman Forge LLP, holding the Chakan forging plant that issues the blanks to job-workers.
orgStructure.openPoint: Tally stays live for this company code in parallel for one year; the retirement date must be decided (pending IQ-27).

reports.name: Stock-at-vendor report by vendor, part and heat (quantity, weight and age per open challan)
reports.purpose: Gives Chakan's plant head and finance a single standing list of what is lying at each of the six job-workers, so the INR 3.2 crore unreconciled balance is worked down to zero and shortages are chased on time.
reports.realization: Proposed: a stock-in-subcontracting view by vendor, part and batch/heat with challan age, delivered as a standard stock report or a key-user analytical view; needs validation because vendor-held stock ageing is not evidenced in the available SAP catalogue.
reports.validationReason: Confirm the standard stock-at-subcontractor report, and whether challan age must be added as a key-user analytical view.

reports.name: ITC-04 report from job-work postings
reports.purpose: Lets finance file the GST ITC-04 return for Chakan (2100) from the same challan and receipt postings instead of the Excel register, and see which challans are still open before the deadline.
reports.realization: Proposed: GST job-work reporting built on the challan and receipt postings, with the filing feed prepared by the GSP; needs validation because ITC-04 output in this release is not evidenced in the available SAP catalogue.
reports.validationReason: Confirm the delivered GST ITC-04 report and the GSP hand-off; pending JBW-OQ-7 for the deadline that applies.

endToEndTests.valueStream: Chakan forging to treated-blanks receipt at Chakan and settlement of the per-kg charge
endToEndTests.given: A Tata schedule for crankshaft blanks arrives and MRP derives a job-work requirement; 900 tonnes a month are forged at Chakan (2100) and a lot of 500 blanks on heat H-4471 goes to a heat-treatment job-worker.
endToEndTests.when: The supervisor releases the lot, the store keeper creates the system challan by part, heat and weight, security checks it at the gate, the vendor reports cracked pieces and returns the lot in two partial deliveries against the challan, and a monthly per-kg invoice is verified.
endToEndTests.then: Stock at the vendor exists per vendor, part and heat from the challan; the cracked pieces are posted as a scrap loss at the vendor with a document; both receipts carry the heat number and quality inspection; the challan lines close; the invoice matches challans, receipts and returned weight before approval; the vendor balance goes to nil.

endToEndTests.valueStream: Chakan issue to direct receipt at Bhosari across the two company codes
endToEndTests.given: Blanks issued from Chakan (company code 2000, plant 2100) are sent by the job-worker straight to Bhosari (company code 1000, plant 1100) because machining needs them urgently.
endToEndTests.when: Chakan posts the system challan, the vendor delivers to Bhosari, Bhosari stores posts a challan-referenced receipt with the heat number against the Chakan challan, and the month-end ITC-04 is worked.
endToEndTests.then: Chakan sees the Bhosari receipt the same day and the lot no longer sits unreconciled at the vendor; the cross-entity posting and transfer price are as decided in JBW-OQ-3; the challan closes and ITC-04 reports the correct path; machining starts only on a posted receipt.

Chakan receives part of the challan line
Bhosari receives part of the challan line for a direct-delivery lot

Every remaining line of the challan is received at Bhosari or rejected

The issue was posted to the wrong vendor, part or heat while the truck is still at the gate

configurationCatalogue.name: System GST job-work challan
configurationCatalogue.purpose: Carries forged blanks to the job-work vendor and is the document the gate check reads.
configurationCatalogue.note: No verified reference for release 2702; consultant to confirm the subcontracting challan document type and its GST-required fields.

configurationCatalogue.name: Subcontracting issue document
configurationCatalogue.purpose: Posts blanks as stock lying at the named job-work vendor per part and heat.
configurationCatalogue.note: Movement type and document type for the subcontracting issue must come from the consultant's SAP cloud release and be confirmed against JBW-OQ-2.

roles.name: Sales coordinator
roles.responsibilities: Takes in customer schedules, runs the planning hand-off and issues steel-index supplementary invoices.

roles.name: Chakan store keeper
roles.responsibilities: Creates the job-work challan at the gate, posts and receives the blanks at Chakan.

sodAssessments.description: The Chakan store keeper both creates the job-work challan that lets material leave and posts the vendor-held stock issue, so a wrong or duplicate challan would not be caught by a second pair of eyes.
sodAssessments.mitigation: The production supervisor releases the lot before the challan can be created (release authority and limits pending JBW-OQ-4) and the security guard re-weighs and clears the truck at the gate against the same challan.

sodAssessments.description: The Chakan store keeper receives returned blanks against the same challans he issued, so a short return could be closed without detection.
sodAssessments.mitigation: The quality inspector confirms heat number and quantity on every receipt, and the finance controller reconciles open challan lines monthly (detail and tolerance pending JBW-OQ-8).

controlMappings.realization: No challan line can be saved without part, heat and weight, and the challan number is what every later receipt and the ITC-04 data set references, replacing the manual register.
A receipt line cannot be saved without a heat number, and the heat number is carried into the batch record for Tata and Hyundai parts.

steps.title: Schedule intake and MRP-driven job-work requirement
steps.trigger: A customer delivery schedule or call-off arrives at Chakan (2100) from Tata, Mahindra or Hyundai through their portals or email, or the German Tier-1 sends its weekly call-off against a quarterly purchase order; on the same cycle MRP is run to derive the forging and job-work requirement.
inputDocuments: Monthly delivery schedule from Tata SupplierNet, Mahindra portal or Hyundai (channel for the other customers pending JBW-OQ-10)
Quarterly purchase order with weekly call-off by email from the German Tier-1
Customer material information mapping customer part number to our blank and machined part number
Forged blank and machined part master data with routings and BOM
Open customer sales orders and stock/requirement situation at Chakan (2100) and Bhosari (1100)
outputDocuments: Customer schedule / scheduling agreement schedule lines per customer part and date
Received-and-accepted schedule log for the incoming schedule files
MRP run record with planning result per blank part number
Planned order / production requirement for forged blanks at Chakan (2100)
Subcontract (job-work) requirement per blank part, quantity and required date for heat treatment and shot blasting
Exception list of schedule lines that could not be posted

actions.operation: Receive the customer schedule file or call-off from the customer portal or email channel and post it as schedule lines against the customer's scheduling agreement; log each receipt with file or message identity, timestamp and result.

Review the received schedule lines and resolve lines the interface could not match; routes for each customer portal and the method of transfer (Tata SupplierNet, Mahindra portal, email for others) remain pending JBW-OQ-10. Do not re-key accepted schedules into a separate tracker.
Confirm or reject a schedule line that the interface matched with a quantity or date difference, and record the reason on the line.

Run MRP at Chakan (2100) over blank part numbers so the accepted schedule lines generate the dependent forging requirement; planning focuses are taken from the part master and the level of detail is per blank part number.

Derive the job-work requirement for the ~70% of blanks routed through the 6 heat treatment and shot blasting vendors, per blank part number and required date; the purchasing side of this requirement is available for the job-work release described in the next step, and the vendor stock view of step JBW-2-2 closes it.
Flag requirement shortfalls and dates that cannot be covered as MRP exception messages for review by the sales coordinator; nothing is issued to a vendor from this step.

exceptions.condition: A schedule file from a customer channel arrives unreadable, in an unknown format, or for a customer not set up in SAP
exceptions.response: The file is stored unposted on the exception list with the error, the sales coordinator and the person responsible for that channel are alerted, and the customer is served from the last accepted schedule until the file is corrected and re-posted.

exceptions.condition: MRP cannot cover a schedule line because billet, forging capacity or heat treatment vendor capacity falls short
exceptions.response: The shortfall is raised as an MRP exception message for the sales coordinator, who decides whether to reschedule, expedite or inform the customer; no goods are issued and no stock is changed by this step.

exceptions.condition: A customer issues a revised or cancelled schedule after MRP has already created a job-work requirement
exceptions.response: The revised schedule is posted and MRP is re-run; requirement no longer needed is removed by the re-run so it cannot be released to a vendor from the following step. Whether a customer may cancel or revise inside a frozen window is not stated by the sources and must be decided by the Head of sales and dispatch.

masterData.object: Customer master with the scheduling agreement type used for monthly schedules and call-offs
fields: schedule channel assigned to the customer

masterData.object: Part master for forged blanks and machined parts
Bill of material and routing linking machined part, forged blank and the heat treatment / shot blasting operation

effects.inventory: None: this step reads requirements and creates planned requirements only; no stock is moved, reserved or issued. Stock lying at the 6 job-work vendors is created and relieved in steps JBW-2-2, JBW-4-1 and JBW-4-2.
effects.financial: None: no invoice, credit or valuation document is created; schedules and the derived requirement change planning figures only. Vendor charges are settled in step JBW-5-1 and steel-price billing with customers is not in this step.
effects.ownership: Unchanged: the blanks remain the property of the issuing entity and no ownership or custody change happens until blanks are released to a vendor in step JBW-2-1; the owning entity of vendor-held stock, including the Bhosari return path, is pending JBW-OQ-3.
effects.accountingEntry: None: intake of customer schedules and the MRP run create planning documents and requirements only, so no debit or credit is posted and no accounting document is created.

steps.addedValue: Customer schedules land once in the scheduling agreement and drive forging and job-work requirement directly, so the sales coordinator no longer re-keys the same schedule into Tally and a separate Excel tracker, and the Bhosari planner and Chakan supervisor work from one requirement picture instead of phone-call releases.

businessRules.condition: A customer schedule file or call-off arrives from any channel
businessRules.response: It is posted into the customer's scheduling agreement schedule lines; the customer part number is translated through customer material information to our blank and machined part number. No manual re-keying into Tally or an Excel tracker is performed for accepted schedules.

businessRules.condition: An incoming schedule line cannot be matched to a customer material number, part number or valid date
businessRules.response: The line is not posted; it is listed on the exception list with the matching error, and the sales coordinator either maps it through customer material information or rejects it with a reason. Processing of the other lines of the same file continues.

businessRules.condition: The same schedule file or call-off is delivered again (customer resend, interface retry)
businessRules.response: The duplicate is detected by the file or message identity and the resulting schedule lines; an identical resend leaves the schedule unchanged and is only logged. A genuinely later revised schedule is posted as a new schedule and is not suppressed.

businessRules.condition: The interface for a customer channel fails or is unavailable
businessRules.response: The failed receipt is logged with the error, the sales coordinator and the person responsible for the customer channel are alerted, and the schedule is re-posted once the channel is available; the receipt is retried by its file identity so no schedule line is duplicated. Which channel and which transfer path each customer portal and the GSP use is pending JBW-OQ-10.

businessRules.condition: Schedules and MRP are handled in this step
businessRules.response: Only schedule intake and the derived requirement are done here. Customer dispatch documents, e-invoicing, steel-index billing and customer rejections are outside this step; whether they are designed in a separate order-to-cash workstream is pending JBW-OQ-1.

businessRules.condition: The step is operated at go-live
businessRules.response: It applies to schedule intake and MRP at Chakan (2100). The vendor-bound requirement covers blanks routed to the 6 heat treatment and shot blasting vendors; inter-plant supply to Bhosari and Hosur and whether Hosur stays in scope are pending JBW-OQ-1 and IQ-18.

businessRules.condition: A customer's schedule channel (Tata SupplierNet, Mahindra portal, email for others) and its technical route are not yet decided
businessRules.response: The schedule is still received and posted into the scheduling agreement, but the concrete channel, protocol and responsible party stay held pending JBW-OQ-10; the design and its acceptance are conditional on that answer.

implementation.detail: No verified catalog entry exists for SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition 2702, so the realisation is NEEDS_VALIDATION. Expected path to validate: inbound schedule interface into customer scheduling agreement schedule lines, MRP planning run for plant 2100, plus the customer-portal and email channels of Tata, Mahindra, Hyundai and the German Tier-1. Validation points: which released interface or file format each customer channel uses (pending JBW-OQ-10), how the German Tier-1 quarterly PO with weekly email call-offs is posted, and MRP run mode and frequency.

acceptanceTests.given: A customer scheduling agreement exists at Chakan (2100) for a crankshaft part whose customer material number is mapped to our blank part number, and MRP is set up for the blank
acceptanceTests.when: The customer's monthly schedule file is received and MRP is run at Chakan
acceptanceTests.then: The schedule lines appear on the customer's scheduling agreement for the listed dates and quantities, a dependent forging requirement and a job-work requirement exist for the blank part number per required date, and no deficit or shortfall exception is raised

acceptanceTests.given: A schedule file contains one line whose customer material number is not maintained in customer material information, and eight valid lines
acceptanceTests.then: The eight valid lines are posted to the scheduling agreement, the unmatched line appears on the exception list with its matching error, and the sales coordinator can map it and re-post it without touching the eight accepted lines

acceptanceTests.given: The same schedule file has already been accepted once and arrives again unchanged as a channel retry
acceptanceTests.when: The file is received a second time
acceptanceTests.then: The duplicate receipt is logged and no schedule line is added or doubled, while a later revised schedule for the same customer is still posted as new schedule lines

acceptanceTests.given: A schedule file arrives unreadable from one customer channel
acceptanceTests.then: The file stays unposted on the exception list with its error, the sales coordinator and the person responsible for that channel are alerted, and re-posting the corrected file creates the schedule lines exactly once

steps.title: Release and system job-work challan at the Chakan gate
steps.trigger: The production supervisor has decided that a forged lot at Chakan (plant 2100) is to go to a named job-work vendor for heat treatment or shot blasting, and he asks the store keeper to issue it.
inputDocuments: Released job-work requirement derived from MRP for the vendor and part
Forged blank stock record at Chakan (plant 2100) with batch and heat number
Supervisor's oral or written daily decision on which lot goes out (today no signed paper)
Job-work contract with the vendor for heat treatment or shot blasting (rate per kg, GSTIN of the vendor)
outputDocuments: System job-work challan per vendor, part, heat number and weight in kg (GST-compliant, lifecycle document)
Issue document that the security guard reads and clears at the gate
Movement document for the transport, carried by the truck driver
Gate clearance record with challan number, truck number and weighed weight at the Chakan gate
GSP transmission record for the movement document sent from SAP (lifecycle document)

actions.operation: Identify the forged blank lot to be sent for heat treatment or shot blasting from the released job-work requirement and ask the store keeper to issue it; the release authority is Pending JBW-OQ-4 and the negative-stock rule is not applied in this step.
fields: target plant for the return (Chakan or Bhosari)

actions.operation: Create the job-work challan against the job-work requirement as an issue to the named vendor with the material provided to it, entering part, heat number, batch and weight in kg.

Verify that the heat number and batch on the lot physically in the store match the challan lines before the truck is loaded; a line with no heat number cannot be saved. The stock deduction is posted by the following subcontract-stock step, not here.
Check the challan number, truck number and the counted pieces and weighed weight on the gate weighbridge against the system challan, and record the gate clearance with any difference in weight.

actions.system: SAP document output and GSP interface
actions.operation: Print the challan for driver and gate and send the movement document for the challan to the GSP for the government portal as a movement (not an e-invoice); a failed transmission is recorded against the challan and shown to the store keeper for re-send. The customer e-invoice part of the requirement is Pending JBW-OQ-1.
Hand the challan to the guard's record and to the driver; the lot is then only allowed to leave the gate with a system challan number.

exceptions.condition: The lot physically in the store carries a heat number different from the one on the challan, or a heat number is missing
exceptions.response: The store keeper stops loading, corrects the challan line to the actual heat number, or holds the lot at the store pending the plant head's decision on how to identify it; no challan is cleared at the gate with a missing heat number.

exceptions.condition: The gate weighbridge weight differs from the challan weight
exceptions.response: The guard records the weighed weight and the difference against the challan and informs the store keeper before the truck leaves; whether the truck leaves at the weighed quantity or is held is Pending JBW-OQ-5.

exceptions.condition: The movement document transmission through the GSP fails at the time of departure
exceptions.response: The store keeper is alerted from the transmission record and re-sends the same movement document for the same challan; the driver carries the printed challan in the meantime.

exceptions.condition: The challan was created for the wrong vendor or part and the truck has already left
exceptions.response: The store keeper raises it to the plant head, who decides the correction, and it is aligned with the posting of the vendor stock in the following step so that vendor stock, gate record and challan agree; no second challan is raised for the same load.

masterData.object: Vendor master record for the job-work vendor
Material master for forged blank parts
Plant and storage location structure for Chakan
fields: raw material and WIP storage locations

effects.inventory: No stock movement is posted in this step: the challan and the gate clearance document the load, and the deduction from Chakan stock and the creation of stock at the vendor are posted by the following subcontract-stock step (JBW-2-2). Whether that posting may create negative stock is Pending JBW-OQ-2.
effects.financial: No expense, revenue or liability arises at challan creation; the job-work charge is billed per kg later and verified by the vendor invoice step. The cost of the blanks stays in inventory until the receipt back.
effects.ownership: The forged blanks remain in the books of company code 2000 (Forge LLP, plant 2100) while they lie at the vendor; only custody passes to the vendor with the truck. Who is accountable for the lot at the vendor's works is Pending JBW-OQ-8 and IQ-23.
effects.accountingEntry: None: no goods movement is posted by this step, so no accounting document is created; the challan is a GST movement document. The accounting entry belongs to the subcontract-stock posting in JBW-2-2 (debit stock at vendor / credit plant stock) and Pending JBW-OQ-2 for the negative-stock case.

steps.addedValue: The store keeper's hand-written triplicate challan and the guard's paper gate register are replaced by one system challan per load that carries part, heat number and weight and is the number every return, invoice and ITC-04 line is posted against, so the heat number is fixed at the moment the lot leaves Chakan instead of being reconstructed later, and the gate can no longer clear a truck whose load has no system record.

businessRules.condition: The store keeper tries to create a job-work challan line without a part number, heat number or weight in kg
businessRules.response: The line cannot be saved and the lot stays in the store; picking is per part, heat number and batch, not per part number only.

businessRules.condition: A truck is at the Chakan gate
businessRules.response: The guard clears it only against a system challan number that exists for that truck's load; without one, the truck is stopped and the store keeper is called. The guard records truck number, weighed weight and pieces against the challan.

businessRules.condition: The gate weighbridge weight or counted pieces differ from the challan weight or pieces, and the tolerated difference is not yet decided
businessRules.response: The difference is recorded on the gate clearance and flagged on the challan; whether a line is blocked, released or escalated, and by whom, is Pending JBW-OQ-5 and IQ-25. Until that is answered no automatic block is applied.

businessRules.condition: The production supervisor has asked for a lot to go out but the release authority and release limits are not yet decided
businessRules.response: The issue is prepared and held: Pending JBW-OQ-4 (production supervisor or plant head, and from what quantity or value). No release is recorded for lots above any limit until the decision is made, and no approver is assumed. Whether the guard check stays as a compensating control is Pending JBW-OQ-4 as well.

It is created as a challan to the named job-work vendor for the named heat and part with weight in kg, and the same challan number is the number every later return and invoice is posted against; this step does not itself reduce plant stock or create vendor stock, which the following subcontract-stock step posts.

businessRules.condition: The movement document transmission to the government portal through the GSP fails
businessRules.response: The challan stays valid and printable for the gate and driver, the failure is recorded against the challan and shown to the store keeper, and the same movement document is re-sent; a resend reuses the existing movement reference of that challan so no duplicate movement is created. The store keeper does not create a new challan to retry.

businessRules.condition: A challan was created in error or the load did not depart
businessRules.response: The store keeper cancels the challan before the gate clearance, with the reason recorded; a challan already cleared at the gate is not cancelled here but corrected or reversed by the step that posted the vendor stock, so the gate, the challan and the posting never disagree. Whether a cancelled challan is re-issued under a new number or a correction is used is Pending JBW-OQ-4 (release authority) with the plant head deciding.

businessRules.condition: A lot is being sent to a vendor and the negative-stock rule the MD requires would be needed because the forged stock is not yet posted
businessRules.response: This step does not post stock and therefore neither allows nor blocks negative stock; the availability and override behaviour is Pending JBW-OQ-2 and is decided where the issue to the vendor is posted.

It applies only to Chakan, plant 2100 in company code 2000; Hosur is not involved and the Bhosari direct-return path is handled by JBW-4-2. Parts for Tata and Hyundai lots carry the heat number on the challan so traceability starts at issue.

businessRules.condition: The customer dispatch, e-invoice, steel-index billing and customer line rejection topics are raised while this step runs
businessRules.response: The job-work movement document is transmitted through the GSP, but the customer e-invoicing part of the requirement is Pending JBW-OQ-1 (whether it is designed in a separate order-to-cash workstream); this step only transmits the job-work movement document.

implementation.detail: No verified SAP catalogue exists for this release, so the realisation is proposed and must be validated in the fit-to-standard workshop: the system job-work challan is expected from the SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition subcontracting and GST job-work document handling, with the material issued to the job-work vendor and the challan output printed for gate and driver. The movement document is sent to the government portal through the GST service-provider interface, and heat number is expected on the challan item. Validation points: challan-issue document type, movement-document type and its GST reporting, heat-number field and its mandatory check, gate weighbridge weight capture and its comparison to challan weight, the transmission-failure status and re-send without a duplicate movement, and the negative-stock setting are all unconfirmed; no object code is claimed.

acceptanceTests.given: At Chakan (plant 2100) a forged lot of 500 crankshaft blanks, part P, heat number H123, batch B01, weight 1,250 kg, is released by the production supervisor for vendor V, and vendor V exists with his GSTIN in the vendor master
acceptanceTests.when: The store keeper creates the job-work challan for part P, heat H123, 500 pieces and 1,250 kg and hands it to the driver, and the guard clears the truck at the gate
acceptanceTests.then: One system challan exists for vendor V with part P, heat H123 and 1,250 kg, its number is recorded on the gate clearance with the truck number and weighed weight, and the same challan number is what later returns must quote; the store keeper's manual triplicate is no longer written

acceptanceTests.given: A truck loaded with blanks is at the Chakan gate and no system challan has been created for that load
acceptanceTests.when: The guard checks the truck against the system challan
acceptanceTests.then: The truck is stopped and the store keeper is called; no gate clearance is recorded, so no material leaves Chakan without a system challan

acceptanceTests.given: A challan has been created for vendor V and the GSP connection to the government portal rejects the movement document, while the truck is ready to leave
acceptanceTests.when: The system reports the failed transmission against the challan and the store keeper re-sends the same movement document
acceptanceTests.then: The challan remains the only challan for that load, the failed transmission and the resend are recorded against that same challan number, and no second challan is created for the same truck

acceptanceTests.given: The release authority and release limits for a job-work issue are still undecided and a lot is being prepared for issue
acceptanceTests.when: The store keeper creates the challan and the supervisor's release is required
acceptanceTests.then: The issue is held as Pending JBW-OQ-4: the challan is identifiable as not released, no approver or threshold is assumed, and no stock is posted by this step; the held condition is shown to the plant head

acceptanceTests.given: The gate weighbridge shows 1,238 kg for a load whose challan states 1,250 kg
acceptanceTests.when: The guard records the weighed weight and the difference on the gate clearance
acceptanceTests.then: The difference of 12 kg is visible on the challan and gate clearance and the store keeper is informed before departure; whether the truck is held or released at the weighed weight stays Pending JBW-OQ-5 and is not decided by the system

eliminatedAsIsSteps.reason: Machining at Bhosari (1100) lies beyond the job-work boundary: the design ends when treated blanks are received and posted against the Chakan challan. The machining order and its confirmation belong to the production planning workstream.

The hand-made per-truck sales invoices between GSTINs are not reproduced. The one inter-company movement the job-work chain creates, the direct delivery to Bhosari, is handled in the Bhosari receipt variant; other transfers belong to the inventory and intercompany workstream.

coverage.rationale: Issues post to vendor-held stock and receipts relieve it, so the monthly reconciliation is built from postings instead of an Excel tick-sheet; every challan line is returned, rejected or aged, which removes the balance the auditor qualified. Detail level and closure tolerance sit on JBW-OQ-8.
The paper triplicate challan and the Excel ITC-04 register disappear: the challan is created in SAP at issue and ITC-04 is filed from the same postings.

openQuestions.question: Customer dispatch with ASN, customer e-invoicing/e-way bill, steel-index retro billing and customer line rejections all lie outside the job-work chain. Confirm whether they are designed in a separate order-to-cash workstream, so their pain points are covered there rather than here.

The MD requires issues to job-workers to post on negative stock. Confirm whether this applies only to job-work issues or to all goods movements in both company codes, who may override a shortage, and how it interacts with Tally running in parallel for the LLP.
